gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-warang-ci: Mystery Quest leans bookish and nostalgic, its curves left open at the jaws and its ascenders tucked short. Noto Sans Warang Citi follows in a plain sans, and its words settle into solid blocks that carry on comfortably down a page.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-yi: Mystery Quest has a nostalgic, bookish look, with compact ascenders and curves that never quite close. Noto Sans Yi takes over in sans-serif, deep through the midsection of its lowercase, so a long page feels modern and steady.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar: Mystery Quest brings a nostalgic, bookish feel through open-jawed curves and compact ascenders sitting over tall lowercase. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square soars with its x-height; give the heading generous size.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-numans: Numans reads modern and clean, with its s hanging wide and its spacing pushed open. Mystery Quest is best as a bookish, nostalgic display voice with open-jawed curves, while Numans does its best work as the quiet, widely tracked text beneath.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-onest: Onest reads approachable and contemporary, with big bowls under short ascenders. Mystery Quest earns its keep when big and short, where its open-jawed curves and bookish, nostalgic air stand against the blueprint-like constant line of Onest.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-open-sans: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic look. Its compact ascenders contrast with Open Sans, a plain sans with bulky lowercase proportions and smooth curves, and that mix of old-fashioned charm and modern smoothness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-orienta: Mystery Quest opens its curves wide and tucks its ascenders in, giving a bookish, nostalgic display voice. Orienta, in sans-serif, answers with breathing counters and little height difference between cases, and that quiet restraint is the pair's best trait.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-oxygen: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest keeps its curve jaws open and ascenders compact. Oxygen, a sans with curves that never close and lowercase nearly matching its capitals, supplies the modern clarity, and that open-handed quality is the pair's strongest point.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-parkinsans: Mystery Quest's open jaws on every curve and compact ascenders give it a bookish, nostalgic personality at display size. Parkinsans, in sans-serif, keeps one stroke thickness and crisp, wide-mouthed letters when shrunk.
